# Visit Okinawa Japan

> > Official travel guide for Okinawa, Japan's subtropical island paradise featuring UNESCO World Heritage sites, pristine beaches, and unique Ryukyu culture.

Visit Okinawa Japan is the official tourism portal for Okinawa Prefecture, covering the main island and remote island chains including the Yaeyama and Miyako Islands. The site provides comprehensive travel planning resources including destination guides, seasonal itineraries, cultural experiences, accommodations, and annual festivals celebrating Okinawan heritage from the historic Ryukyu Kingdom era.

## Key Topics

- Okinawa Main Island
- Yaeyama Islands
- Ishigaki Island
- Miyako Islands
- Ryukyu Kingdom Heritage
- UNESCO World Heritage Sites
- Naha City
- Northern Okinawa (Yambaru)
- Remote Island Tourism
- Traditional Crafts (Yachimun Pottery)
- Awamori Spirit
- Beach Resorts
- Stargazing & Dark Sky Parks
- Cultural Festivals
- Subtropical Climate & Seasons

## Island Destinations

- [Ishigaki Island](https://visitokinawajapan.com/destinations/yaeyama-islands/ishigaki-island): Yaeyama gateway island with Kabira Bay and Iriomote-Ishigaki National Park
- [Kurima Island](https://visitokinawajapan.com/destinations/miyako-islands/kurima-island): Remote Miyako island with beaches, stargazing, and Ryugujo Observatory
- [Kuroshima Island](https://visitokinawajapan.com/destinations/yaeyama-islands/kuroshima-island): Yaeyama island for sea turtle watching, snorkeling, and stargazing

## UNESCO World Heritage & Culture

- [Zakimi-jo Site (Zakimi Castle Ruins)](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/world-heritage-top/zakimi-castle-ruins): UNESCO World Heritage castle ruins built by Gosamaru in Yomitan
- [Awamori: Okinawa's Iconic Spirit](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/food-and-longevity/awamori-okinawa-spirit): Guide to awamori distilled spirit made from Thai rice and koji

## Seasonal Travel Planning

- [Okinawa in June](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/when-to-visit-climate-seasons/okinawa-june): June travel guide: rainy season crafts, flowers, and WWII history sites
- [Okinawa in March](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/when-to-visit-climate-seasons/okinawa-march): March travel guide: spring weather, hiking Yambaru, and pottery events
- [How to Get Around Nanjo City Without a Car: A 2-Day Bus Trip Itinerary](https://visitokinawajapan.com/recommended-trip-tag/culture): 2-day bus itinerary for Nanjo City featuring Sefa Utaki heritage site

## Festivals & Events

- [Naha Great Tug-of-War Festival](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/events/naha-tug-of-war-festival): October Guinness Record tug-of-war with 43-ton rope on Kokusai Street
- [Southern Island Star Festival](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/events/southern-island-star-festival): August stargazing festival at Ishigaki's International Dark Sky Park
- [Okinawa Marathon](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/events/okinawa-marathon): February marathon through Katsuren-jo UNESCO site and coastal views
- [All-Okinawa Yachimun Pottery Market](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/events/okinawa-yachimun-pottery-market): March pottery market and workshops at Hotel Moon Beach in Onna Village
- [Okinawa International Carnival](https://visitokinawajapan.com/discover/events/okinawa-international-carnival): November festival on Gate Street with food, parade, and tug-of-war

## Accommodations

- [JUSANDI](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/accommodations/jusandi): Luxury suite villas in subtropical forest on Ishigaki Island
- [KAYATSUMA OKINAWA HOTEL & RESORT](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/accommodations/kayatsuma-okinawa-hotel-resort): Adult-only private villas in Nakijin near Kouri Island
- [Oriental Hotel Okinawa Resort & Spa](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/accommodations/oriental-hotel-okinawa-resort-spa): Northern Okinawa resort hotel near Kyoda Interchange in Yambaru region
- [Blue Ocean HOTEL &RESORT MIYAKOJIMA](https://visitokinawajapan.com/plan-your-trip/accommodations/blue-ocean-hotel-resort-miyakojima): Miyako Island resort with villa rooms near Irabu Ohashi Bridge

## Travel Inspiration

- [Get a Birds-Eye View of Okinawa](https://visitokinawajapan.com/travel-inspiration/helicopter-view-okinawa): Excel Air helicopter tours over Kerama Islands from Naha Airport
- [Explore Naha by Bicycle](https://visitokinawajapan.com/travel-inspiration/naha-by-bicycle): Self-guided cycling tour of Naha from Shuri to Naminoue Beach
- [Taste Brown Sugar from Okinawa's Eight Remote Islands](https://visitokinawajapan.com/travel-inspiration-area/other-remote-islands): Explore brown sugar specialties from eight remote Okinawan islands
